# BO Studio

> Freelance studio of Oussema Bouchahwa in Sfax, Tunisia: video editing, AI agents and automation, websites and mobile apps, for creators, agencies and small businesses, mostly in France.

Oussema Bouchahwa is a computer engineering student (IPSAS Sfax), full-stack developer and video editor, with about 1.5 years of development work across 3 companies. Languages: Arabic, English, French. Time zone: UTC+1.

## Services and prices (euros)

### Video editing

- Single reels: €15
- Pack of 8 reels per month: €95 per month
- 1 podcast episode into 5 clips: €55
- YouTube video up to 15 min: from €40

### AI agents and automation

- Simple automation: from €90
- AI assistant: email, leads, FAQ: from €180
- Monitoring and fixes: €18 per month

### Websites and apps

- Landing page: from €150
- Business site, up to 5 pages: from €270
- Flutter mobile app: from €360
- Online store: from €480

## How an order works

- A quote within 24 hours.
- 50% deposit to start and the balance on delivery, by international bank transfer. Monitoring and fixes has no deposit.
- Delivery: a reel in 48 hours, an automation in 3 to 7 days, a landing page in about a week. Other work gets a date in the quote.
- Video: 2 rounds of changes included, and a free test reel on request.
- AI agents: a working demo before the balance is paid.
- Websites: built with React, with Vercel hosting set up. Mobile apps are built with Flutter, on request.
- Agencies: white label.
